hookups.source: https://www.lakefiveresort.com/ ('Our Full Service sites provide water, electric, and septic hookups', 'Our Lake Sites offer water and power hook-ups') + ResNexus site descriptions (e.g. 'Full Service RV 5: Shaded, back in RV site with water, 50AMP electric, and septic port'; Lake Sites 30/20 or 50/20 AMP with water), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 14 Full Service RV sites (water, electric, septic port), 12 Lake Sites (water/electric, 'lake access'), and about 30 shaded water/electric campsites (A-Z, OV1-3, U2), almost all back-in (OV3 is a pull-through). Most hold 26-40 ft; some take a 40-ft-plus rig with a $10.10/ft/night overage, by arrangement. A historic 1920s campground: 'Make sure your RV does not exceed the described length of the site reserved.'

sites.source: ResNexus site descriptions for Lake Five Resort (each site's type, hookups, 'Holds one RV up to N feet'; 'Campsite OV3: Shaded 'pull through' RV site') + https://www.lakefiveresort.com/policies ('Please make arrangements with the office if your trailer exceeds 40 feet in length as select sites can accommodate longer trailers with an overage charge of $10.10 per foot over 40', per night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Beach and upper restrooms; token-operated showers; coin laundry. Dump station free to guests during or at the end of a stay (a charge on arrival); honey-wagon tank pumping $35.35. Wi-Fi (Starlink) only from the office toward the stage, not at the campsites. Firewood and bug repellent sold in the office. Private beach with swimming docks, 16 dock slips.

facilities.source: https://www.lakefiveresort.com/policies ('The beach restrooms, and upper restrooms with token operated showers are open to our guests', 'There is a laundry room with a utility sink, coin-op washer, and dryer', 'We have a dump station, free for guests to use on departure or during their stay (we do charge for dumping on arrival)', 'Wi-Fi signal is broadcast from the office towards the stage and does not extend to our cabins or campsites') + https://www.lakefiveresort.com/, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online through the operator's ResNexus page. THREE-NIGHT MINIMUM for advance reservations; 'For less than three nights, we are first come, first served, day of arrival.' Reservations recommended June 20 - August 20. 50% deposit; half of it refunded with 30+ days' notice, none after. Check-in 3-7:30 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Rates include two people (extra adult $10.10/day, child $7.50, dog $10.10).

booking.source: https://www.lakefiveresort.com/policies ('We have a three night minimum for advance reservations. For less than three nights, we are first come, first served, day of arrival.', 'Reservations are recommended June 20th to August 20th.', 'We require 50% deposit payment at time of reservation', 'Site prices include the first two people, each additional adult is $10.10, each child (17 and under) is $7.50 per day', 'Dogs are $10.10 per day') + the ResNexus booking page (same policy text), read 2026-10-22

note: Resort on the south shore of Lake Five near West Glacier, homesteaded in 1915 and built in the 1920s; full-service RV sites, water/electric 'Lake Sites', shaded water/electric campsites, cabins and dock slips, with a private beach and swimming docks. Trains run on the far side of the lake. Towing: come in by the paved Lake Five Road; the owners advise against Belton Stage from US-2. --Claude
summary: Operator's site, policies page and ResNexus booking page: confirmed water hookups and online booking; added 50-amp electric and sewer (Full Service sites), sites to 40 ft (some longer with an overage) with one pull-through, showers/laundry/dump, and a three-night minimum for advance reservations (shorter stays first-come day of arrival). Not stated: nightly rates (none shown out of season), season dates, total site count. Note trimmed of the booking platform and RV Life line.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator advertises 'full service and waterfront RV sites' and sells 12 'Lake Sites' described as 'Lake access' RV sites with 'views of the lake'; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
Standing minimum: 'three night minimum for advance reservations' (recorded in booking.min_stay); stays under three nights are first-come, first-served on the day of arrival.
Rates not found: the booking page shows no prices out of season and the site posts none (RV Life $$$$, avg $116); the US$50 gate is lifted here (Glacier NP gateway, per inclusion_evidence).
